title: CAUSALPATH
subtitle: ERC Grant — Causal Discovery from Biological Pathways
description: Development of next-generation causal analysis methods inspired by the induction of biological pathways from cytometry data. The project aims to bridge causal discovery and biological pathway analysis.

title: JADBio AutoML Platform
subtitle: Automated Machine Learning for Biomedical Data
description: A fully automated machine learning platform designed for biomedical researchers with no programming background. Supports classification, regression, and survival analysis on omics and clinical data.

title: ML4Microbiome
subtitle: Machine Learning for Human Microbiome Studies
description: A COST Action network focusing on the application of machine learning methods to human microbiome research, covering feature selection, biomarker identification, disease prediction, and treatment.

title: Lung & Mesothelioma Cancer Screening
subtitle: Blood test for early detection in high-risk individuals
description: Development of a blood test for screening of smokers and asbestos-exposed individuals to detect lung cancer and mesothelioma at an early, curable stage using liquid biopsy and AutoML.

title: BioDataome
subtitle: Uniform Preprocessing of Public Genomic Datasets
description: Creation of a large database of uniformly preprocessed and disease-annotated genomic and epigenomic data. Currently includes 7,345 datasets spanning 847 diseases, enabling large-scale meta-analysis.

title: ETIA — End-to-end Causal Analysis
subtitle: Automated causal discovery pipeline
description: Development of ETIA, a comprehensive automated causal discovery pipeline that handles preprocessing, causal graph learning, and causal effect estimation in an end-to-end fashion.

title: DIADEx
subtitle: Predictive Explanation of Data Anomalies
description: Research and development of methods for predictive explanation of data anomalies, resulting in a best paper award at BDA 2021. Produced the DIADEx software tool.

title: T2DM Liquid Biopsy Biosignatures
subtitle: Machine learning for Type 2 Diabetes diagnosis
description: Application of AutoML to identify circulating cell-free DNA methylation signatures for accurate diagnosis and monitoring of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, achieving AUC of 0.927.
